import numpy as np


def linear_regression_normal_equation(
    X: list[list[float]], y: list[float]
) -> list[float]:
    X = np.array(X)
    y = np.array(y).reshape(-1, 1)
    X_transpose = X.T
    theta = np.linalg.inv(X_transpose.dot(X)).dot(X_transpose).dot(y)
    theta = np.round(theta, 4).flatten().tolist()
    return theta
